This is this year's Christmas champion belt...

I'm just an ordinary blacksmith, but as a Pseudo-Servant, suppose I can at least imitate the ways of a warrior, too.[r]
Hm? Why the look? You somehow look both smug and surprised at the same time...[r]
Maybe I showed up a bit too early...
Saber, Senji Muramasa. I've come in answer to your summons.[r]
I was wondering why I was made into a Saber, but now I've got an idea as to why.[r]
...While he has nothing to do with the me that's been summoned here, the fact remains that he had the same face as me, and he went and raised hell.[r]
Work me as hard as you like.
Tam Lin Gawain...and I will now fight under your banner.[r]
What's with that look on your face? Is there something strange about my face?[r]
Hm? It's not me, but my name is what's strange to you?[r]
...I-I see. Well in that case, that's fine...[r]
(You're not telling me that the real Sir Gawain is here, are you?)[r]
Servant, Saber.[r]
I am Barghest, and I have come in answer to your summons.[r]
I may not have the right to say something like this, but...[r]
As repayment for you attending and watching over the end of Britain, I will wield my sword for you until my life ends.[r]
It's been a while, Master. I am Majin Saber, back from the boundless beyond.[r]
Hm? Wait a minute...what the heck's happening...?[r]
Wh-what just happened?[r]
Is this some kind of joke?[r]
Are you...Rengoku? You're so cute now.[r]
What do you mean, cute? What the hell!? I even sound like you, Wielder![r]
Hey, I think I've shrunk a little too...Whatever. Please take good care of both Rengoku and me, Master. [r]
We really shouldn't just breeze by this. Hey, I think you're even acting differently, Wielder.[r]
You think so? Now that you mention it, you may be right, but maybe not.[r]
Argh, this is nuts! Anyway, I'm really counting on you on so many levels, Wielder's Master![

infos.text: “I'm not frivolous enough to join in on the festivities,[r]but I'm happy to take requests. I am a prince, you know.

[r]
Just don't expect any sweet developments, okay?”

[r]
“Accept my gift of the fragrance of paradise as you continue on your journey.[r]Ah yes, it's a beautiful rose, but don't fret.

[r]
My flowers have no thorns.”
“What's going on, Archer? You must be losing your touch as a sniper if you're getting hit by a spearman's gun!”

[r]
“Heh. Must be because he spends all his time in the kitchen, cooking three-course meals, including dessert!”

[r]
“I have to admit your surprise attack from the shallows took me unawares! Plus you're using the latest water gun!

[r]
I suppose even that spear you're so proud of is obsolete now!”

[r]
“Ha, I only did it to be on the same level as you! I borrowed it from the Saber in the green cape!”

[r]
“What!? Impossible, I've been asking to borrow it every five minutes!

[r]
Why have you got the King of Knights' gun!?

[r]
And I thought I rented this whole place out―who gave you permission to enter!?”

[r]
“(The younger) You did!!!”
“Farewell, great detective...”

[r]
“This isn't over...

[r]
I'll chase you 'round perdition's flames before I give you up. It's my job as detective to close this case once and for all!”

[r]
“I've come this far. I'll stick with you until the very end, too!”
“Looks like the perp escaped into this alley... We'd better play it safe, Senpai.”

[r]
“Hey, relax, kid. Don't get all stiff and serious. It's best to take this kinda thing nice and easy.”
“Ah, the young prince, what is your business with me tonight? Surely you haven't come here to befriend me.”

[r]
“Must you always be obfuscating? Did you think I wouldn't see through your pretense of barbarity?”

[r]
“If you are not truly resolved, it would be better to leave.”
“I hope your ride has been comfortable for you, sir. Please don't hesitate to ask for anything.”

[r]
“Thank you. This cabin is simply wonderful. I look forward to your hospitality throughout the trip.”

[r]
“We are off to a good start. May luck follow you on the journey you're about to take...!”
“You humans are so arrogant that you never once stopped to wonder whether tomorrow would actually come.

[r]
Now, the path that once looped endlessly has at long last fixed upon a final destination.”

[r]
“I—we, are going to seize our future with our own hands!”

[r]
“Seabirds naturally make their way to land, even if the sight of it may be obstructed by thunderclouds in their path. They know land is where they'll find hope.”
“Yo, Mandricardo.[r]Didja hear?”

[r]
Steamed meat buns are fifty yen off right now.”

[r]
“I just got paid, so ya know what that means...I'm payin'.[r]I'll even throw in a drink! You're comin' with us, yeah?”

[r]
“Uh...y-yeah. I'll hang out with you guys.[r]Thank you for treating me!”
“Mmmmmm! ...Hooked it a bit to the right. Not quite the exquisite swing I was going for.”

[r]
“Hey, nice shot! Considering your curious appearance, you sure put a lot of power behind that swing, Douman!

[r]
All right, my turn now. This might be ambitious, but I'm going to try to reach the green in one stroke!”

[r]
(It would be a fool's errand to try to compete with these two in terms of sheer power, especially in the long haul. Not to mention it would be murder on my poor back!)
Hey...what the heck are you doing, Roland!? Are you telling me you want me to aim for THAT target?

[r]
What of it? A paladin must always be brave.

[r]
Keep the mischief to a minimum, you two. And you should know that I always get serious in a game, even if it's for fun!

[r]
You both know what happens if you lose...right?

[r]
(Both) Y-your Imperial Majesty...!
I'm glad you could make it. A relaxing trip will be good for you, Master.

[r]
Let us rest our wings together, my children, my Romans.

[r]
M-me, too?

[r]
Our Divine Father insists. We have a great deal of ground to cover, so I hope you're ready!
So young! So green! But that's not a bad thing, really. They say hard work in youth is quiet rest in old age, you know?

[r]
Consider this a VALUABLE lesson from your elder.

[r]
I will not relent... Even if the answer is already evident, I will not accept it! I will never grow up to be like you!

[r]
Honestly, you both are quite childish.
The feeling of witnessing my archenemy in such a state is...difficult to put into words.
Brought lunch from home again, Yamanami?

[r]
I should follow your example instead of just chugging highly caffeinated drinks and calling it a day.

[r]
I just threw some leftovers together, so it is nothing fancy.

[r]
You're more than welcome to try a bite. I can't guarantee it will satisfy your palate, though.

[r]
By the way, I recently started a Pankration course geared towards setting some of the more unruly students straight.

[r]
Would you two be interested in attending, for some light exercise?

[r]
(Both) No, thank you.
Helldyste! So this is a flower-viewing!

[r]
We love sunbathing, so this is great! What about you, Hua-hua?

[r]
Hm. I hear there's a custom of viewing cherry blossoms in Master's hometown, and I do agree it's quite nice.

[r]
My sons also seem to be enjoying themselves.

[r]
Whoa! The petals look like they are dancing!

[r]
Careful not to run around too much!

[r]
There are sweets and tea too.

[r]
This one's mine! First come, first served!
Hm, are you the new guy who joined last month? You look like a hard worker.

[r]
Oh, David. Great work as always! I'm sorry I didn't introduce myself earlier.

[r]
Don't worry about it. Your smile is enough for me. But you know, I wouldn't take that route if I were you.

[r]
Take that road instead. It might look like the longer way round, but it's actually more efficient.

[r]
I see. Thanks for the advice!

[r]
And there's also some perks to the job. See that bakery across the bridge?

[r]
The girl, Abishag, who runs that shop is so beautiful.

[r]
Uh...huh. Abishag...?

[r]
All right, you two, we should start our deliveries. Let's get going before the sun sets!
My hands are worthy to grasp the flag of victory. Don't you agree? Ooh la la!

[r]
Yeah, that's golden! The Genji excel in battles you can't back down from!

[r]
A place for true men to compete against each other, huh!? Then, as a warrior, I can't help but get excited!
And that's when my spear pierced the giant...right between the eyes!

[r]
Oh ho. Having a drink with heroes means there's no shortage of nonsense stories of valor.

[r]
As long as the stories flow, so will the drink. The more the story is seasoned, the better it pairs with a drink, you know.
Should the veil of darkness shroud the forest, one need only shed light upon it.

[r]
Hmmm. Warm. Bright. Lobo, are you feeling okay?

[r]
(Growls sleepily)
Back when I was the Imperial Governor...

[r]
Douman! Your countless atrocities shall not be forgiven! The arrow of justice shall pierce your schemes.

[r]
I can't stand idly by knowing the people of this country can't even enjoy a good meal without worrying for their well-being. Prepare yourself!

[r]
Mmmmm, very well! Very well! I shall trample upon those noble thoughts!
What? You're curious about this thing? You've got a good eye. I was real particular about its materials.

[r]
Well if you like it so much, it's yours.

[r]
Why?

[r]
Well, your god isn't so crude as to answer, you know?
Little enough will change if it simply churns and boils. But, depending on how well it is prepared, it may become a delicacy like fermented salted organs.

[r]
The same can be said of fate, yeah?

[r]
Personally, I prefer something sweet.

[r]
At the very least, I hope the bitterness doesn't overshadow the beauty of this scene.

[r]
God is merciful, but quite mischievous. So it is human nature to be tossed about by His whims,

[r]
but sometimes it's best to surrender oneself to the flow of things. Is that not also one of life's delights, my friends?
The future me has the potential to become a Caster...

[r]
It's not really sinking in for me, but I might as well try out this magecraft thing while I have the chance!

[r]
That applies to me too, then. While we're at it, why don't we study together?

[r]
There are a few things about this academy I'd like to investigate.

[r]
The time of resurrection is near...I suggest you eagerly anticipate for that moment to come, young monsters.
I've heard the ruffians in town have been acting up lately. We can't just sit back and do nothing about it, can we, Hijikata?

[r]
Of course not. I'm not about to give any credit to those shady Special Investigation Unit guys. Shinsengumi, head out!

[r]
Not that we really have room to talk about looking shady...
Hey, you okay there? Your hands stopped.

[r]
(This is odd... The dice keep coming up the same. Something's wrong.)

[r]
You must be delusional for trying to challenge me to a game of dice!

[r]
I don't know which Rider you call yourself, but you're still green. Dahahahahaha!

[r]
...Please stop talking. And I am not a Rider. I'm a Saber!
What do you think of my library, my young up-and-coming King of Conquerors? I also carry a wide variety of editions of the “Iliad”.

[r]
You never cease to amaze me, Ptolemaîos! This is the library of my dreams!

[r]
There's even a giant “Iliad”!

[r]
I am glad it is to your liking. Please enjoy it.
You can never have enough things to protect you from evil. A hero like me is bound to run into a storm or two.

[r]
All right, I guess I'll take that one too.

[r]
Well, watery calamities are one thing, but I can't guarantee it will protect you from the female variety.

[r]
Besides, I've already decided who's going to get this batch of thread.
Hey Master, you all right? I heard you collapsed while you were out farming mats.

[r]
Does it hurt anywhere? Can you talk?

[r]
Thank goodness your fever went down.

[r]
Pushing yourself may be admirable, but please take it easy and get some rest today, Master.

[r]
I have prepared a meal. You hardly get enough nutrition from just eating apples, so if there is anything you would like, I will get it for you immediately.

Present, start.[r]
My heart's racing.

I wish you luck.[r]
Rolling in big batches is the better deal.

Are you getting some sort of hunch?[r]
Do not fret, it's just your imagination.
Competing over how many boxes you can open is futile. What's most important is your smiling face filled with a sense of accomplishment after pulling an all-nighter.

Forgotten.[r]
Please look forward to an electrifying encounter.

Fate floods in like a downpour.[r]
Ready to take a photo of it?

Remembering this roll will probably[r]
make me cry. Yes, me, Dumuzid.

Just call my name when things get too tough.[r]
Nothing special will happen, though.

I had a dream that we were drowning in[r]
a sea of materials. It was just a dream.

That was a good joke.[r]
Don't give up. Try rolling again.

Automutton. Wonderful.[r]
It feels like my flesh is burning.
It's so beautiful to the point that it's cruel. Perhaps we should consider entering the Cannes Festival.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 8

infos.text: This is going to be a long battle. Try not to get your hopes up. Just relax, relax.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 9

infos.text: It's mesmerizing, seeing so many things spinning in circles.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 10

infos.text: Hm!? I have a feeling something big's coming! You can believe me! Santa's intuition is never wrong!

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 11

infos.text:
Here! Full throttle! Turn towards India![r]
Are you ready to get tossed into the air in celebration, Master!?
infos.dialogText: It feels like this is going to be a big one...

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 12

infos.text: Hm. An average result. This is just right.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 13

infos.text: Were there things you wanted? Even if you don't need them now, they'll be useful in the future. So it's best to store them.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 14

infos.text: Don't get discouraged. You just need to pick yourself up as many times as it takes. Your goal for this year should be to be indomitable.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 15

infos.text: Presents are endless. Keep at it until you run out of time.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 16

infos.text: Hit! Landing a direct hit is so satisfying! Oh...uh...nothing. I'm calm.

scriptJson.overwriteName: Merry Christmas in the Snowy Field 2025 - 7 Days/8 Years Snow Carol 17

infos.text: Ah, congratulations! All right, all Marines, assemble! I'll allow you to throw Master into the air!
